QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Stopping the Flow
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the rest of Jack's story.
QuestInfo.1: To stop Naricain's followers' plan, Jack suggests turning the tables on them by invading their stronghold before they can do anything. Enter the Crimsonwood Keep.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to enter the keep, but the entrance was sealed up, leaving you to wonder what you should do now.
